worldcombat.skill.hydrocannon.summary: Raise water to its limit and fire one straight high-pressure jet: the hit shoves the target back and soaks it through, and an already-soaked target takes a heavier follow-up; the user is left spent, unable to act or move.
worldcombat.skill.hydrocannon.descriptio: The jet deals about %1$s special damage on a hit.
On a hit the target is shoved %1$s blocks along the jet; the jet's hit radius is %2$s blocks.
A struck target is soaked for %1$s; against an already-soaked target (carrying a soak marker, or simply wet) this shot deals %2$s more damage.
The jet reaches %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; wind-up %3$s, then the user is spent for %4$s, unable to start moves or ordinary attacks and unable to move.
worldcombat.skill.hydrocannon.use.1: Shove a target back and soak it through
worldcombat.skill.hydrocannon.use.2: Follow up on an already-soaked target
worldcombat.skill.hydrocannon.preference: On: the jet narrows into a faster lance - higher damage and a stronger shove, but a narrower hit that misses more easily and a longer spent window. Off: the water spreads, hitting a wider area more reliably, but with lower damage, little shove and a faster recovery.
Below this health fraction the companion stops firing (unless the target is nearly down). Higher avoids leaving a spent opening.
On: when a candidate carries the soaked identity, the companion switches to it - the jet hits a soaked target harder. Off: it only fires at the proposed target.
worldcombat.skill.hydrocannon.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.hydrocannon.growth.0: From level 36 the jet gains another step with level.
worldcombat.skill.hydrocannon.growth.1: From level 56 it steps up again.
